entities.summary:
Adobe Inc. is an American multinational computer software company founded in 1982 by John Warnock and Charles Geschke. Originally focused on PostScript page description language, Adobe pioneered desktop publishing and became the global standard for creative and digital marketing software.

Adobe's development of PostScript enabled laser printing and transformed the publishing industry, while PDF (Portable Document Format), released in 1993, became the universal standard for digital document exchange worldwide. Photoshop, acquired in 1989 and released commercially in 1990, redefined image editing, creating an entirely new profession of digital designers and making 'Photoshop' a verb synonymous with digital manipulation.

Adobe's Creative Suite — encompassing Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere, and After Effects — became essential tools for graphic designers, filmmakers, photographers, and web developers globally. The company's transition from perpetual licenses to Adobe Creative Cloud subscriptions in 2012 became a landmark case study in software business model transformation. By 2023, over 26 million users subscribed to Creative Cloud, generating $17 billion in annual revenue.
